entry.summary:
Watch Kate Ngatokorua talk about how adornment influences her life as a Cook Islands woman, and the Western trope of Pasifika women being perceived and portrayed as anonymous exotic dusky maidens.

https://tepapa.nz/DuskyMaidens

The subtitles are available in English, te reo Māori and Cook Islands Māori. As YouTube doesn't have the Cook Islands Māori language listed, the Cook Islands Māori subtitles are listed as Tongan.
